en: This vintage postcard presents a sepia-toned photograph of a serene coastal landscape with two small islands in the foreground. One island features a small whitewashed building, likely a chapel or monastery, while the other, in the background, has a dense cover of trees and the ruins of an ancient structure. Mountains rise gently across the bay. Decorative handwriting and printed text are visible at the bottom, including a date (15.5.1900) and terms in French and Greek. The card is titled 'Souvenir de Corfou,' with 'Pontikonissi' printed on one side.
